name: Ranch Dressing
title: Ranch Dressing
ingredients: 1/2 cup mayonnaise (, either store-bought whole egg or homemade)
1 tsp apple cider vinegar or lemon juice (, or other clear vinegar)
2 tbsp finely chopped chives (, or 1 tsp dried chives)
2 tbsp finely chopped parsley (, or 1/2 tsp dried parsley)
1 tsp dried dill (, or 1 1/2 tbsp finely chopped fresh dill)
1/2 tsp garlic powder (, or fresh garlic finely grated using a microplane)
instructions: Whisk all ingredients together until the dressing is smooth. Leave in the fridge for 2 hours to let the flavours meld before using.
Use as a dressing or dip for everything from wings to chips, veggie sticks or even bread!
